name: Esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
aliases: E472, E472a, E472b, E472c, E472d, E472e, E472f, esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids, diacetyltartaric acid esters of mono- and diglycerides, DATEM, ésteres de los mono y diglicéridos de ácidos grasos
what_is: A group of emulsifiers made of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids esterified with organic acids like acetic, lactic, citric, or tartaric acid.
why_botia: It flags it because the fatty acid backbone can have either animal or plant origins, posing religious and dietary tracking uncertainties.
can_1: Identify E472 subclass codes (a to f) and their corresponding names on a label.
can_2: Flag the ingredient as potentially derived from animal fats.
cannot_1: Ascertain whether the starting fatty acids were extracted from plant oils or animal fat tissues.
cannot_2: Measure the percentage of unreacted free glycerol or free organic acids in the final product.
title: Esters of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
description: A group of emulsifiers made of mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids esterified with organic acids like acetic, lactic, citric, or tartaric acid.
